column1: # ha_tone.tsv — Hausa word→tone lexicon. Word→tone facts extracted from Wiktionary via
# kaikki.org (https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Hausa/) and re-encoded in our own H/L/F/R
# notation. A word's tone is a linguistic FACT, not copyrightable expression — credited
# here as provenance, not as a licensed work. Tone is not derivable from spelling, so the
# Pattern is one code per vowel nucleus: H high · L low · F falling · R rising. All-Low
# words are omitted (privative-H convention). Out-of-lexicon words are left untoned.
